nodes.label: SemVer metric registry with alias resolution
Fetcher struct (cache-first endpoint fetcher with sharded in-memory cache)
New() constructor — creates Fetcher with cache, http client, shards
Fetch() — cache-first fetch with stale fallback on API failure
resolveURL() — dispatches endpoint key to provider URL builder
resolveTTL() — looks up per-endpoint TTL from config with bounds clamping
apiKey() — returns provider API key from config
AllEndpoints() — returns all known endpoint keys
ParseGlobalDominance() — extracts BTC dominance % from body
DerivativesData struct (total OI, median funding rate, exchange count)
ParseDerivativesResponse() — aggregates BTC perpetual OI + median funding rate
SPPStableIDs — top-18 stablecoin CoinGecko IDs for stablecoin-power
StableCoinMarket struct (id, symbol, market_cap, volume, 24h change, price)
ParseStablesMarketsResponse() — parses stablecoin markets JSON array
BTCReference struct (24h price change extracted from markets response)
CoinMarketsBreadthData struct (per-tf green/total, coin count, BTC ref)
CoinMarketsBreadthEntry struct (multi-tf price changes per coin)
ParseCoinMarketsBreadthResponse() — computes per-tf green counts, excludes nulls
CoinMarketsMomentumData struct (price changes, volumes, market caps)
CoinMarketsMomentumEntry struct (24h change, volume, market cap)
ParseTopGainers() — extracts top N gainers sorted by 24h change desc
CoinMarketsRankedCoin struct (rank, symbol, 24h change, market cap)
median() — median of float64 slice (avg of 2 middle for even len)
PeggedAsset struct (id, symbol, name, current/prev circulating)
AggregateSupply() — sums peggedUSD across all assets (current+prev)
CLIResponse struct (status, ts, results[], error?) — top-level envelope
MetricResult struct (metric, version, status, data, meta?)
WriteSuccess() — writes successful CLIResponse JSON to stdout
WriteError() — writes error CLIResponse with CLIError to stdout
Config struct (APIs, Cache, Output, Metrics, SourceOverrides)
Load() — loads config from file (delegates to LoadWithViper)
LoadWithViper() — viper-based config load with env, flags, perms check
Write() — writes default config template to path
SourceFor() — datapoint→endpoint mapping with override support
StoreInContext() — stores Config snapshot in context
PersistentPreRunE (config init, flag validation, logging setup)

attributes.description: Central registry for versioned metric providers with semver-based resolution and core-namespace priority
Controlled-precision float64 serialization with configurable decimal places
Confidence-threshold-based status mapping with thin-data downgrade
